syntax = "proto3";

package test;

option (o) = {
  foo: "goo" // trailing foo
  /* before an elided comma */
  bar: 1
  /* last, before the comma */
};

message Foo {
  oneof choice {
    string a = 1;
  }
  // after a dropped semicolon

  message Bar {
    int32 x = 1;
  } /* block before */
  // and after
}
// after a top-level dropped semicolon
